# CMHA Peel Dufferin

> > CMHA Peel Dufferin provides mental health and addiction services, housing support, and community programs across the Peel and Dufferin regions of Ontario.

The Canadian Mental Health Association Peel Dufferin branch serves communities throughout Peel and Dufferin, offering case management, substance use services, housing and homelessness support, and recovery education. The organization is accredited and maintains partnerships with CMHA National and other provincial branches.

## Key Topics

- Mental health services
- Substance use and addictions
- Housing and homelessness support
- Suicide prevention
- Community mental health programs
- Case management
- Recovery College
- COVID-19 pandemic response
- Mental health awareness campaigns
- Peel and Dufferin regions
- Accreditation and quality standards
- Public health and safety
- Bell Let's Talk
- Indigenous Peoples mental health
- Accessibility standards

## Core Programs and Services

- [Case Management](https://cmhapeeldufferin.ca/programs/case-management-dufferin): Case management services for mental health support in Dufferin
- [Brief Services - Substance Use](https://cmhapeeldufferin.ca/programs/substance-use): Brief substance use and addiction support services program
- [Housing and Homelessness](https://cmhapeeldufferin.ca/housing-and-homelessness): Housing support and homelessness services in Peel and Dufferin regions
